caption: Landporten, Nyborg
composition: A yellow gatehouse in the grass ramparts · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Landporten is a long yellow-washed gatehouse with one large brick arch, set between grass ramparts, with dark moat water and a linden path. The path is empty. The night is overcast, about 10.9°C. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. The castle and the marina are not in this frame.
